profile: trading (inline, second project; extraction to ~/harness/templates/trading/ is now owed)
rules: A build unit reaches 'passing' ONLY when its verification command exits 0. The agent never self-declares done.
A thesis leaves 'measured' ONLY via an independent evaluator subagent scoring a forward-only record against a metric pre-registered before the result is seen.
No thesis reaches 'live' on an agent's say-so. That transition is a human decision with recorded evidence.
WIP=1 applies to build units: exactly one 'active' at a time.
No build unit may validate itself against an already-resolved question. Forward-only, always.

theses.name: calibrated-edge-over-market-price
theses.thesis: On thin political markets (down-ballot races, low-liquidity process questions), a well-informed individual's probability estimate beats the market price's own Brier score, with positive resolution in the Murphy decomposition, by enough to survive fees and capital lock-up.
benchmarks: The market price at forecast time, scored the same way on the same questions. This is the free and unarguable benchmark; beating it is the definition of edge.
theses.blocked_on: F05 has reported. The minimum is ~80 independent event clusters at a 10% edge, ~320 at 5%. Pre-registration is pinned once forecasting breadth makes one of those reachable, and before the holdout completes, so git ordering proves the bar came first.

build_units.title: Append-only hash-chained forecast journal
build_units.behavior: Records a pre-resolution probability with the market price at forecast time, an event-cluster key, and a UTC stamp, appended to data/forecasts/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl and chained by sha256 to the prior record. A revision is a new append, never an edit. Writing a forecast for a market whose close time has passed raises. Probabilities of exactly 0 or 1 raise.
build_units.evidence: 44 tests green at 1de0b11; `python -m journal.record --check` exits 0 on an intact chain. Invariants mutation-tested before the green was accepted: weakening the close-time guard, relaxing the strict 0<p<1 check, and severing the chain link each fail a specific test. Commit-reveal added on top (docs/decisions/0003); the nonce closes a brute-force leak that would have made the public commitment decorative.

build_units.title: Manifold API client
build_units.behavior: Reads open markets and their current prices, pulls resolutions for recorded forecasts, and places positions. Stdlib-only for the read path so the daily record cannot be broken by a dependency.

build_units.title: Sufficiency pre-flight (KILL-GATE)
build_units.behavior: Analytical table of how many resolved forecasts, clustered by correlated-event group, are needed to detect a real Brier edge at stated effect sizes. Requires no data. If the answer exceeds what a season can produce, the project stops and a refusal ADR is written instead of an apparatus.
build_units.evidence: 30 tests green; --preflight exits 0. Derivation validated three ways: hand-computed values, the closed form (m-p)(m+p-2Y), and 200k-draw Monte Carlo agreeing with E[d]=e^2 and sd=2|e|sqrt(q(1-q)). VERDICT: S01 is testable but only at a 10%+ edge on genuinely thin markets, and only through breadth across unrelated clusters. The midterms are ~1 observation, not 400. See docs/decisions/0004.

build_units.title: Brier scorer with Murphy decomposition
build_units.behavior: Scores the journal against outcomes and against the market-price baseline, decomposing into calibration, resolution, and uncertainty, with a reliability diagram. Calibration alone is not skill: a model always returning the base rate is perfectly calibrated and has zero resolution.

build_units.title: Trial log and ladder discipline
build_units.behavior: Records every configuration evaluated including abandoned ones, computes effective N for correlated trials as rho + (1-rho)*M, rounds reported scores to the ladder threshold eta, and records a new best only on an improvement exceeding eta. Costs an hour and is worthless if started late.

build_units.title: Resolution tracker
build_units.behavior: Polls venues for resolutions of open forecasts and appends outcome records to data/resolutions/, joined to forecasts by id. Never mutates a forecast record.

build_units.title: Position and disclosure log
build_units.behavior: Append-only, publishable as written, current at the moment any related published piece goes out. Verifies that no prior entry changed. No --force flag exists.

build_units.title: Research loop with claim-level verification
build_units.behavior: Decomposes research output into atomic claims, re-retrieves each cited source, and verifies the claim against the source text rather than checking that the link resolves. Prefers depth on few sources over breadth across many, because search depth degrades factual accuracy.

build_units.title: Base-rate book
build_units.behavior: Reference classes for recurring question shapes: incumbent reelection rates, midterm seat change by presidential approval band, special-election swing as a leading indicator, confirmation and passage success rates. The outside view, consulted before the narrative.

build_units.title: Event-clustered inference
build_units.behavior: cluster_ttest and block_bootstrap over correlated-event groups with a pinned seed. Forecast-level input raises: N forecasts on one national environment is one observation, not N.

build_units.title: Clark-West nested comparison
build_units.behavior: One-sided MSPE-adjusted comparison against the market-price baseline. Required because a forecast is the market price plus an adjustment, and an unadjusted test on nested models almost never rejects even when the edge is real.

build_units.title: Market scanner
build_units.behavior: Ranks open markets by the gap between the recorded estimate and the market price, weighted by liquidity and time to resolution.

build_units.title: Correlated-race partial pooling model
build_units.behavior: Partial pooling across races with heavy-tailed population priors and non-centered parameterization. Normal priors overshrink exactly the outliers an election model exists to catch. Never inverse-gamma on a variance parameter: it has no proper limiting posterior and silently forces complete pooling.

build_units.title: Calibration-gated sizing
build_units.behavior: Fractional Kelly on binary contracts, modelling capital lock-up to resolution. Raises on ungated input, on a scalar mean where a distribution is required, and on correlated positions with no correlation argument.
